note: Regression fixture for the bracket-depth bug in the Phase 0 splitter. A comma inside an array subscript is not an operand separator, so MOV(Recipe[Row,Col],Active_Setpoint) is a two-operand MOV and not a three-operand one. Measured on the Egan corpus the bug affected 3 rung bodies and 36 operands across MOV (28) and COP (8); it never inflated the tag count, because the split produced one unresolvable tag plus one spurious literal. An index expression is asserted to produce a read edge on the index tag: the controller genuinely reads Row and Col to compute the address, and dropping those edges would hide a real data dependency. The base tag is the subscript target, so Recipe[Row,Col] resolves to the tag Recipe.
